The one other spike, with less damage in all than the 4 above (time, length, damage taken per second: the healing cooldowns up in it, by the same rule): 4:49-4:54 (5 s) 1.85M/s: Ascendance (Enfo) at 4:53
Who was meant to press which healing cooldown isn't in the log, and The Dragonfell Tribe has no raid note saved for The Twin Fangs that night; a healing cooldown ready and unused isn't a missed assignment (raids plan each cooldown for chosen moments and hold it through the others).
